trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the receipt for everything else: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no separate task, no multiplayer and no DLC to chase — the whole list lives in single-player Leonida. Plan on about 200 hours, and treat A Long Road as the real final boss: the story is 60–80 hours, the 100% checklist about 100, and cleanup about 10.
steps: Finish the five story chapters and the final mission.
Work the 100% completion checklist until A Long Road pops.
Sweep the eight Strangers & Freaks strands and the side-character finales.
Check the tracker for the last stragglers, then earn the final one — the platinum follows at once.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game and the second gold: reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), which only becomes visible after the story. The good news is that it asks for roughly 60% true completion, not everything — 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges — and everything you did during the story already counts. Work it county by county from the checklist itself, not from memory: the numbers are in this guide's 100% checklist view.
steps: Finish the story to unlock the checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Clear the robbery rows first: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults, and the fencing totals.
Then the collectibles: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 flamingos, 200 vehicles, 100 animals.
Then the activities: 42 shooting range golds, 42 drone time trials, 300 stunts, 30 race wins, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 Bret target decks.
When the checklist reads 100%, the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description points to driving out through the showroom window, but the exact trigger is NOT CONFIRMED yet — pick a vehicle showroom, get in a car inside it, and drive out through the glass. If one showroom does not pop it, try another. This entry flags it as unconfirmed rather than guessing at a method.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom and get into a car inside.
Drive out through the showroom window.
If it does not pop, try a different showroom — the exact trigger is still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, then lose the police. The trophy's description is a bowling joke, but the job is a robbery: hit the Kingpin Bowling operation, take the take, and break the wanted level that follows. It also counts toward the 39 gang operations the 100% checklist wants.
steps: Go to the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn.
Rob the operation.
Lose the police that respond.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Working out together trains both at once, so take the two of them to the gym and grind Strength together rather than one at a time. It is a slow stat, so fold gym sessions into the cleanup stage between other jobs.
steps: Take Jason and Lucia to a gym together.
Train Strength for both characters — working out together trains both.
Keep at it until Strength is maxed for both; the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Take 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. The counter rises from ordinary criminal play — robberies, thefts, getaways — so it builds on its own across a full playthrough, and the cleanup grind will finish it. One warning from PowerPyx: do not push toward the Irredeemable profile. It is permanent, so spread your actions and do not chase the darkest profile tier.
steps: Play criminally: robberies, thefts and getaways all move the Criminal Profile.
Let the counter build across the story and the 100% checklist.
Reach 500 profile actions; avoid pushing into the permanent Irredeemable profile.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — a running total, so every laundered dollar counts. Yasmani pays the most of the contacts, so route your marked bills through him. Marked bills come from robberies, and the 100% checklist wants the same $250,000 fenced, so this trophy finishes alongside the robbery rows of A Long Road.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies.
Launder them through your contacts — Yasmani pays the most.
Reach the $250,000 running total; it also clears the checklist's Marked Bills row.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, as a running total. You will hit it naturally if you buy gear as you go — weapons, ammo, clothes, car parts — so do not force it early; just keep the counter in mind while shopping during the story and the 100% phase. If it is still short at the end, buy the most expensive weapon mods you have not bought yet.
steps: Buy gear as you play: weapons, ammo, clothes, car parts.
Watch the running total in the Progress menu.
Top it up with weapon mods if it is short at the end.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all eight purchasable garage properties, about $160,000 in total. The four story garages do not count — only the eight you buy yourself. Money from the robbery phase covers it: run the gang operations and bank jobs first, then buy the garages in one sweep and the trophy pops with the eighth deed.
steps: Earn money from robberies and fencing (about $160,000 is needed).
Buy each of the eight purchasable garage properties.
The trophy pops with the eighth garage — story garages do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which Moses gives you in Chapter 2. You need free garage space for each registration, so clear room first — buy the garages for Little Boxes or clear out stored vehicles. Then register ten different vehicles through the app; each one counts once.
steps: Get the Scooter Bros app from Moses in Chapter 2.
Make sure you have free garage space.
Register 10 different vehicles through the app.
